_about: Small seed created 2026-10-31 from docs/DATASET-SPEC.md section 6 and docs/04-data-model.md. Range phrases below are explicit demo conventions, not a general interpolation rule. Field cues transcribe the Phase-1 prompt with generic shortened notification/responsible-party phrases observed in source snapshots. P4 Phase4 readiness receipt fd4c771 identifies the additional notification header 'Số Giấy công bố' in captured listing specs#25; it is a field-label cue only, tested with unrelated values, not a statement that any document or number is valid. Negation cues, separators and common sentence abbreviations are conservative extraction conventions reviewed in P2-1, not regulatory assertions. S2 adds direct assistant-addressed imperative cues observed in the stored injection snapshot and English synthetic variants; each instruction-bearing sentence is excluded independently. Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid and Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate family membership was checked 2026-10-31 against Table 1 definitions at https://www.cir-safety.org/sites/default/files/SLR_HyaluronicAcid_092022.pdf. This is broad ingredient-family normalization only, not product membership, concentration or performance equivalence.
